title: Risk Strategy & AI Transformation, Director - RQA
description: About this role BlackRock's purpose is to help more and more people experience financial well-being. As a fiduciary to investors and a leading provider of financial technology, we help millions of people build savings that serve them throughout their lives by making investing easier and more affordable. Risk & Quantitative Analysis (RQA) is at the center of BlackRock's investment and technology platform. RQA provides independent oversight, risk analytics, portfolio insights, model governance, and strategic risk advisory across the firm's investment and technology activities. As BlackRock accelerates its 2030 strategy, AI transformation and Private Markets growth represent two of the most important strategic priorities for the firm. RQA is playing a central role in both. About the Role We are seeking a highly motivated Director to join RQA's Strategy & AI Transformation team. This individual will act as a senior delivery leader across some of the firm's highest-profile strategic initiatives, spanning AI transformation, Private Markets risk management, operating model redesign, and cross-functional innovation programs. The role will partner closely with senior leaders across RQA, Technology & Operations, BlackRock AI Labs, BLK Next, Digital Workplace, Aladdin, PMG Tech, and Private Markets businesses to drive execution of a multi-year transformation agenda. Success in this role requires exceptional organizational leadership, executive presence, strategic thinking, and the ability to translate ambitious ideas into tangible outcomes. This position is based in New York and will work directly with senior leadership across the firm. What We Are Looking For The ideal candidate combines the execution discipline of a world-class program leader with the curiosity and adaptability of a startup operator. They are comfortable navigating ambiguity, building relationships across senior stakeholder groups, and driving complex initiatives from concept through implementation. Most importantly, they are excited by the opportunity to help shape the future of risk management, AI-enabled decision making, and Private Markets at BlackRock. Key Responsibilities Strategic Program Leadership Lead the day-to-day execution of a portfolio of strategic initiatives across AI transformation, operating model redesign, and Private Markets risk management. Drive program governance, prioritization, milestone management, dependency tracking, issue resolution, and executive reporting across multiple workstreams. Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership on program execution risks, resource allocation, and delivery strategy. Coordinate complex initiatives involving stakeholders across RQA, AI Labs, Technology, Aladdin, Private Markets, and corporate functions. AI Transformation Support execution of RQA's AI strategy and flagship transformation initiatives, including the firm's "Big Rocks" program. Partner with business leaders to identify, prioritise, and scale AI-enabled workflows. Coordinate efforts across AI governance, model validation, AI risk management, technology teams, and business stakeholders. Help establish repeatable operating models, governance frameworks, and adoption strategies for AI solutions across RQA. Track value realisation, productivity gains, and business outcomes associated with AI investments. Private Markets Strategy & Innovation Support the evolution of BlackRock's Private Markets risk management operating model. Coordinate strategic initiatives spanning Private Credit, Private Equity, Infrastructure, Real Estate, and related risk functions. Work closely with investment, risk, analytics, and technology teams to drive implementation of new capabilities supporting BlackRock's growth ambitions in private markets. Facilitate collaboration across legacy BlackRock and HPS and GIP teams to accelerate integration and harmonisation efforts. Executive Engagement & Stakeholder Management Develop materials and recommendations for senior leadership forums, including ExCo and GEC-level discussions. Prepare strategic updates, business cases, operating model proposals, investment requests, and executive communications. Influence stakeholders across organisational boundaries without direct authority. Represent the team in senior meetings and act as an extension of leadership when required. Operating Model & Team Development Help design scalable operating models for AI-enabled risk management. Contribute to workforce transformation efforts, including AI adoption, capability development, and organisational effectiveness. Support development of governance frameworks, delivery standards, and best practices across strategic programs. Identify opportunities to improve execution discipline, transparency, and cross-functional collaboration. Required Bachelor's degree required. 8+ years of relevant experience in strategy, transformation, program management, consulting, technology, risk management, or related fields. Demonstrated experience

title: Director, Applied AI
description: ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. You’ll be surrounded by teammates who care deeply, challenge each other, and celebrate wins. With tools that amplify your impact and a culture that backs your ambition, you won’t just contribute. You’ll make things happen–fast. You'll lead the team that builds the intelligence every ZoomInfo AI agent reasons over — what's true about companies and the people in them, how they relate, and what they're buying. This role owns the B2B data graph strategy end to end, from training data through model serving, blending classical machine learning and data science with LLM and agentic systems. You'll set the technical bar for a small, senior team while staying hands-on, shipping code and prototypes alongside the engineers you lead. What You'll Do You will extend ZoomInfo's B2B data graph into the long tail, making it the most comprehensive and accurate resource available, including companies with little public footprint. You will lead the team's work on agent memory, distinguishing what a user has supplied from what a system of record already owns. You will choose the right method for each problem — classical machine learning, language models, or code — based on measured evidence, and stop work that won't pay off. You will define the evaluation bar for the team's models and agents, building evaluation datasets, regression gates, and experiment designs that make quality claims trustworthy. You will own inference cost, latency, and capacity as core disciplines alongside model quality, including build-versus-buy and distillation decisions. You will hire and develop machine learning engineers, data scientists, and research engineers, growing senior engineers into technical leaders. You will represent the team's work across product, platform, security, and legal, and present results and their limits clearly to executives. You will set the standard for how the team uses agentic coding tools, pairing precise specifications with rigorous code review. What You Bring Must-Have: You have significant, demonstrated experience building and shipping production machine learning systems, and you lead by building alongside your team — capability matters more than years. You have a track record of hiring and developing senior machine learning engineers and data scientists against a high bar. You stay hands-on today: shipping code, prototyping independently, and using agentic coding tools daily with rigorous review. You bring deep classical machine learning and data science expertise (supervised learning, feature engineering, statistical inference, experiment design, strong SQL) alongside production LLM and agentic systems, with the judgment to choose between them, including setting evaluation standards such as leakage-safe validation and calibration. You have owned inference cost, latency, and capacity alongside model quality, including build-versus-buy decisions, and you communicate results and their limits clearly to executive stakeholders. Preferred: You bring entrepreneurial experience — founding a company, or taking a product from inception to paying customers as a founding or early engineer. You have experience in propensity modeling, ranking and retrieval, clustering, or entity resolution at scale. You have worked on web-scale language processing over multilingual, noisy text, knowledge graphs, or user memory for agents. You have experience with post-training and distillation, open-weight model serving, or AI governance and safety practices (ISO/IEC 42001, NIST AI RMF).     #LI-Remote #LI-VC1 Actual compensation offered will be based on factors such as the candidate’s work location, qualifications, skills, experience and/or training.
